title: OpenRTB 2.6 Geo
description: Encapsulates various methods for specifying a geographic location.

lat.description: Latitude from -90.0 to +90.0, where negative is south.

lon.description: Longitude from -180.0 to +180.0, where negative is west.

type.description: Source of location data. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Location Types.

lastfix.description: Number of seconds since this geolocation fix was established.

ipservice.description: Service or provider used to determine geolocation from IP address.

region.description: Region code using ISO-3166-2; 2-letter state code if USA.

regionfips104.description: Region of a country using FIPS 10-4 notation (deprecated by NIST in 2008).

metro.description: Google metro code; similar to but not exactly Nielsen DMAs.

city.description: City using United Nations Code for Trade & Transport Locations.

utcoffset.description: Local time as the number +/- of minutes from UTC.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.
